tabInfo.upg100Region: Region — sort the UPG100 lists by world area (Africa, India, Middle East, Deaf, …). Counts are the UUPGs and population summed across every list beneath it.
tabInfo.upg100Zone: UPG100 Lists — each one is a prayer list of the unreached people groups in an area, and is what the map paints and colours. Every list prints as its own packet.
tabInfo.upg100Group: People Group — the individual unreached groups inside a list, largest prayer need first. Each map dot is one of these.
tabInfo.family: Lang Family — a group of languages descended from a common ancestor (e.g. Indo-European, Afro-Asiatic).
tabInfo.language: Language — a system of communication used by a people (e.g. Arabic, Bengali, Hindi).
tabInfo.dialect: Dialect/Variety — a regional or social form of a language (e.g. Arabic, Sudanese; Pakistan Sign Language).
tabInfo.bloc: Affinity Block — the broadest grouping, by cultural, linguistic and geographic kinship (e.g. Malay Peoples, South Asian Peoples, Deaf, Arab World).
tabInfo.cluster: Cluster — a finer grouping inside a block (e.g. Borneo-Kalimantan within Malay Peoples). Rows are marked “(Cluster)” to tell them from people groups.
tabInfo.group: People Group — an ethnolinguistic identity on its own terms, independent of country. Rows are marked “(PG)”. One group may live in many countries (the Deaf, for example, in over a hundred).
tabInfo.pgic: PG in Country — one row for each people group in each country it lives in (e.g. “Abai Sungai, Malaysia”). Rows are marked “(PGIC)”.
tabInfo.region: WAGF Region — the macro-region a country belongs to (e.g. Asia, Africa). Each has its own colour on the map.
tabInfo.block: WAGF Bloc — the sub-grouping inside a region (e.g. South East Asia, West Africa).
tabInfo.country: Country — individual countries, ordered by unreached population within their bloc.

export.packetExplain: A prayer list of about 50 to 100 unreached people groups — one person can carry one.
